name: Guangdong Vanward New Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Vanward New Electric Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells household appliances in China and internationally. It offers gas-fired instant, air source, and electric water heaters, as well as gas-fired water boilers, hobs, ovens, grills, and electric fireplace products. The company also engages in the provision of customer support services; asset management; and trading. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Foshan, China.
